interpretation.propagation_signal: The saved trajectories can test whether a reference-directed parameter update changes only nearby source-grid boxes or also moves distant unobserved boxes, and whether that change is directionally aligned with the nearest reference correction.
interpretation.scope_limit: This is descriptive evidence from a fixed set of teacher references and shared Query/LayerNorm parameter updates. It does not establish GT correctness, motion-consistent transport, or a causal benefit of a propagation-specific penalty.
interpretation.observed_case_conclusion: The saved updates are not consistently localized around anchors or directionally aligned with the nearest teacher correction. HC02 changes nearly the whole grid with similar near/far magnitude; HC14 has far-field movement at least as large as near-field movement and near-zero correction alignment; V04 has modest near-to-far attenuation but still changes every saved frame beyond 1e-3. Across the six cases with any actual fits, the pattern varies by case/arm. This is enough to motivate a targeted propagation hypothesis, but not to support a specific propagation penalty or claim benefit.
interpretation.matched_arm_conclusion: When A and C share one gated anchor (HC02), their saved full-grid paths are exactly equal, consistent with normalized outer weighting canceling a single positive scalar. HC14 and V04 have distinct A/C paths; those differences reflect the evidence-aware loss weighting/gate and do not by themselves establish better propagation.
interpretation.proposal_threshold: A propagation-specific method is not supported solely by smooth final boxes or by anchor-IoU improvement; it would need a separately locked matched update that changes only the propagation mechanism and evaluates unobserved/full-tube behavior.
interpretation.case_focus: HC02, HC14, and V04 trajectories are included as named cases; no post-seal score was read or used to select step/configuration.
